parole.significato: An ancient Illyrian tribe inhabiting Enchele.
parole.testo: From Ancient Greek Ἐγχέλιοι (Enkhélioi), from ἔγχελυς (énkhelus, “eel”). Possibly from the Illyrian cognate of the word, itself closely related to Albanian ngjalë (“eel”).
